instruction: A candid outdoor photograph shows a partner acroyoga pose. On large beige concrete blocks under a bright, cloudy sky, the man in the black t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) squats to support the woman in the black crop top and denim shorts (R1). The woman balances on his thigh with her left foot while extending her right leg horizontally. They hold hands with one arm each to maintain balance, looking at one another. The eye-level full shot captures the athletic feat in warm, natural daylight with soft shadows.
elements: R2 squats as the base supporting R1's weight from below
R1 balances on R2's thigh with her left foot
R1 extends her right leg horizontally while R2 supports her
R1 and R2 hold hands with one arm each to maintain balance
large beige concrete blocks serve as the performance surface
outdoor setting under a bright cloudy sky
